name: Briefing
description: Builds a concise summary of calendar, email, and message context from configured source endpoints.
tagline: Turns your calendar, email, and message context into a focused daily briefing.

ownedSettings.label: Daily briefing schedule
ownedSettings.description: Cron, model, prompt, and run parameters.

fields.label: Calendar, email, and message endpoints
fields.helpText: One HTTP(S) endpoint per line. Endpoints can be native APIs, internal exports, webhooks, or JSON/text snapshots.

fields.label: Bearer token env vars
fields.helpText: Comma-separated environment variable names. The first variable with a value is used as a Bearer token.

fields.label: Context notes
fields.placeholder: My working hours are 09:00-18:00 Europe/Rome. Highlight meetings needing preparation and unanswered urgent messages.
fields.helpText: Optional instructions, priorities, account names, or pasted context to include in every run.

fields.label: Publish report to Item Bus
fields.helpText: When enabled, each run publishes the report as a briefing.digest item.
